purpose: Canonical evidence layer for generating and reviewing all Mikhail Razakov CV/portfolio variants. CV copy is downstream; this file stores claims, evidence boundaries, recruiter signals, and role fit.

evidence_levels.PUBLIC_REPO_DIRECT: Directly inspectable source code, tests, build contracts, or checked-in repository evidence.
evidence_levels.PUBLIC_REPO_ATTRIBUTED: Repository documentation attributes a result to an external organizer, but the external primary artifact was not independently retrieved in this pass.
evidence_levels.PRIVATE_DOCUMENT: Private document or correspondence available to the user; safe for factual use but not publicly verifiable.
evidence_levels.USER_ATTESTED: Explicit user statement; do not upgrade to public verification.
evidence_levels.PRIOR_REPO_FORENSICS: Claim established by a prior repository-forensics pass against historical code/commits; retain provenance and re-audit before making it a headline if the exact date matters.
evidence_levels.INFERENCE: Analyst interpretation. Never present as a raw fact.
evidence_levels.NEEDS_VERIFICATION: Potentially useful claim with insufficient evidence for strong resume wording.

cv_generation_rules: Every resume bullet must trace to one or more asset IDs in this knowledge base.
Prefer the strongest evidence relevant to the target role, not the most recent or most fashionable keyword.
Keep professional experience separate from personal/open-source chronology.
Use compiler/runtime work as depth evidence even in broad architecture/system CVs; do not let it disappear from the canonical profile.
Do not let historical projects consume one-page CV space individually; use a compact lineage statement or a portfolio-history page.
Do not generalize benchmark or contest metrics beyond the exact measured/official boundary.
If a stronger claim is only USER_ATTESTED or NEEDS_VERIFICATION, either qualify it or request the minimal artifact.

Inspect Junior diplomas/final protocol for the literal 'absolute/overall winner' claim.
